method: blind A/B, same-model-tier generation (only system prompt differs: plain vs SKILL.md), footer stripped before judging, separate blind judge, both orders judged to cancel position bias, plain-text verdicts
notes: 1 of 25 original prompts dropped: the plain-baseline agent spontaneously ran the skill's process, contaminating that pair. 24 clean pairs remain.
Same provider (Anthropic) generates and judges -> 'preferred under a blind same-provider judge', not 'objectively better'.
Small N (24). Short-form tasks produce many near-ties; treat as directional.
